baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from لِتَغْفِرَ through fingers in ears, garments drawn over the self, persistence, and doubled self-magnification.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call offers forgiveness as a cover that shields from consequence, but the hearers manufacture rival covers: they disable receptive hearing, wrap the self, bind the refusal, and enlarge the refusing self. The response inverts received protection into self-made insulation.

activation_trace.role: Calling by voice to draw near supplies the incoming relational movement that the body blocks.
Forgiving as covering a fault and shielding its bearer supplies the offered protective cover.
Turning something into a state marks the barriers as deliberately produced conditions.
Listening and receptive hearing identifies the precise faculty disabled by the fingers.
A covering veil supplies the outer layer of the manufactured insulation.
Clothing and the self figured as garment makes the cover both material and self-enclosing.
Binding and tying converts a momentary refusal into a fastened posture.
Grandeur and self-magnification supplies the expanding ego that seals the insulating sequence.

changed_reading.before: They reject a request for forgiveness by blocking sound and hiding under clothes.
changed_reading.after: They answer an offered shield from consequence with a rival shield of their own making, protecting the refusing self from the very reception through which protection could arrive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُلَّمَا governs a repeatedly rebuilt sequence: call, made barriers, persistence, and emphatically repeated arrogance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Total recurrence plus deliberate making and firm resolve turns the verse from one refusal scene into a self-stabilizing circuit. Each summons is met by rebuilding the same sensory, bodily, volitional, and status defenses.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness gives كُلَّمَا an exhaustive every-occurrence scope.
The recurring voiced summons supplies the repeated input to the circuit.
Beginning or continuing an action casts barrier-making as maintained practice.
Insistence and firm resolve supplies the circuit's persistence across repetitions.
Contending and overcoming makes the emphatic arrogance an attempt to defeat the summons rather than merely avoid it.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists several simultaneous gestures of refusal.
changed_reading.after: The verse reconstructs a practiced feedback circuit in which every new call elicits the remaking and hardening of a complete defensive posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context makes the summons an advance warning that offers both shielding forgiveness and a delay before an approaching, fixed endpoint. The self-made barriers in 71:7 therefore consume a rescue interval: they block the notice whose reception could alter what happens before arrival.

activation_trace.role: The focus offer of shielding forgiveness is the blocked means of protection.
Receptive hearing is the focus gate closed during the available interval.
Warning that awakens caution defines the message as actionable notice rather than bare speech.
Advance or approach supplies the before-arrival window in which warning can work.
Coming and arrival supplies the event toward which the warning interval runs.
Contextual forgiveness confirms that the warning carries a shielding outcome.
Deferral to a later time supplies the temporary opening and its eventual closure.
A fixed temporal limit makes non-reception costly rather than neutral.

structural_cues: 71:1 places warning before an arriving painful punishment, while 71:4 pairs forgiveness with deferment and repeats that the appointed term is not deferred once it arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, before/arrival, forgiveness, delay, and a fixed term; I infer that hearing is the action gate by which the interval can be used. A live alternative is that the temporal language only frames urgency without making the bodily blockade a mechanism of lost time.

changed_reading.before: The gestures reject a general offer of pardon.
changed_reading.after: The gestures actively waste the finite advance-warning interval in which pardon and delay remain reachable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding report says the call increases only flight; كُلَّمَا then exposes how that inverse gain is implemented. More summons do not merely fail but recruit renewed barrier-making, persistence, and competitive self-enlargement.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive recurrence turns the preceding increase into a repeated response law.
Maintained action supplies the rebuilding step through which flight keeps increasing.
Increase and growth define the counterintuitive positive gain on the rejecting response.
The voiced call is the repeated input that produces the opposite movement.
Flight and escape identify the output whose growth 71:7 renders bodily.

structural_cues: 71:6 restricts the result with إِلَّا to increased flight, and 71:7 follows with كُلَّمَا plus a coordinated escalation of acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increase, call, flight, exhaustive recurrence, and maintained acts; I infer a feedback arrow from repeated summons to trained defensive escalation. The alternative is a looser rhetorical restatement with no claim about learning or reinforcement.

changed_reading.before: Repeated calls repeatedly meet the same refusal.
changed_reading.after: Repeated calls strengthen an inverse-response loop: the attempted approach becomes fuel for increasingly practiced escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night and day, raised public address, explicit announcement, and hidden speech sweep across time, volume, visibility, and privacy. Because the same resistance survives this channel variation, 71:7 reads as a receiver-side blockade rather than a mismatch between one message format and its audience.

activation_trace.role: Receptive hearing locates the failure in the receiving faculty.
The covering veil generalizes the blocked receiver beyond the acoustic channel.
Calling by speech supplies the communication held constant across modes.
Night and its darkness supplies one temporal and perceptual setting of the channel sweep.
Day opening in light supplies the contrasting temporal and perceptual setting.
Public declaration and raised voice tests the overt high-audibility mode.
Making something manifest supplies the visible and public pole.
Concealment in the interior supplies the private pole without changing the refusal.

structural_cues: 71:5 spans night and day; 71:8-9 then contrasts public, announced, and secret address after the bodily blockade of 71:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a systematic variation of communicative settings; I infer that persistence across them localizes the failure to reception. A live alternative is that the modes emphasize prophetic effort without analytically testing channels.

changed_reading.before: The people block one audible encounter.
changed_reading.after: Their ears and garments embody a channel-invariant receiver failure that remains closed under every tested mode of approach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The renewed call to seek forgiveness opens into sending, gushing, connected extension, productive enclosure, and rivers. Against that circulation, fingers and garments become valves that close the human inlet; the refusal blocks not just information but participation in an offered system of replenishment.

activation_trace.role: Shielding forgiveness is the focus offer later unfolded into material replenishment.
Receptive hearing supplies the inlet deliberately stopped.
Repeated shielding forgiveness explicitly initiates the following promise sequence.
Sending and release starts the outward movement of provision.
Abundant issue from a source supplies the high-flow character of the promise.
Connected increase that supplies another makes replenishment a continuing transfer.
A garden covered by trees supplies a productive form of enclosure that contrasts with defensive garments.
Opening and widening until flow supplies the opposite topology to sealed reception.

structural_cues: 71:10 commands seeking forgiveness; 71:11-12 then coordinate descending rain, extended wealth and children, gardens, and rivers as consequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a forgiveness-to-flow sequence and focus barriers; I treat hearing as an inlet whose closure prevents participation in that circulation. The alternative is that the provisions are persuasive rewards with no hydraulic relation to the body imagery.

changed_reading.before: The physical barriers prevent a message from entering.
changed_reading.after: The physical barriers act like closed valves in a wider economy of sending, gushing, extension, shelter, and flow, refusing replenishment at its human point of entry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question about divine وَقَار carries both dignity and an ear-heaviness branch. Read back through 71:7, the group manufactures literal heaviness at the ear while withholding reverential weight, then enlarges itself against a creation presented as measured stages and ordered layers.

activation_trace.role: Receptive hearing supplies the bodily site where counterfeit weight is installed.
Regarding something as great locates the scale judgment that the self redirects toward itself.
The heart's expectant orientation makes وَقَار a withheld inward valuation.
Heaviness in the ear supplies the surprising material bridge back to plugged ears.
Dignity and composure supplies the reverential gravity displaced by bodily blockage.
Measured formation supplies an objective scale against self-magnification.
Successive stages place human size within an ordered developmental sequence.
Layering one level above another expands the scale that exposes self-enlargement as mismeasurement.

structural_cues: 71:13 asks why they do not accord God وَقَار, and 71:14-16 immediately moves through human stages, seven layered heavens, moon, and sun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ear-heaviness and dignity under one context root plus measured stages and layers; I infer a contrast between manufactured bodily weight and withheld reverential weight. The live alternative is that ear-heaviness is only a distant branch coincidence and وَقَار functions solely as honor.

changed_reading.before: Plugging ears and acting arrogantly are adjacent but separate signs of refusal.
changed_reading.after: The plugged ear becomes counterfeit gravity: they install physical weight where reverential weight should be, then compensate by magnifying themselves against a measured cosmos.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later creation sequence moves from ordered layers through emergence and outward exit to a spread earth and wide traversable passes. The focus body reverses that topology: it layers cloth to close, inserts fingers into openings, and turns penetration from passage into blockage.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate state-making casts the body as an intentionally constructed closed space.
A covering veil supplies the closing layer of the body's reversed topology.
Closure or adhesion that prevents extension exposes the restrictive potential of layering.
Passage to the outside supplies the promised outward direction opposed by self-enclosure.
Spreading and extension against contraction supplies an open field for movement.
Penetrating along a path supplies the sanctioned form of passage.
Insertion of one thing into another formally mirrors fingers entering ears but reverses insertion's function from passage to stoppage.
An extended traversable road supplies the route that open space is meant to support.
A wide open pass between barriers supplies the spatial opposite of stopped apertures.

structural_cues: 71:15-20 sequences layers, growth from earth, return and exit, the earth spread as a carpet, and the purpose clause that people traverse wide paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering layers, outward exit, spreading, insertion, and wide paths; I infer a topological reversal between world-opening and body-closing. A live alternative is that the creation survey establishes power without mapping spatially onto the gestures of 71:7.

changed_reading.before: The people use body and clothing as simple barriers.
changed_reading.after: They construct a miniature anti-world: where creation opens layers into emergence and paths, their layered body converts apertures and insertion into terminal blockage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later account expands the plural gestures into an allegiance system: they exit the messenger's obedience, follow accumulated wealth, execute a great collective scheme, command one another not to relinquish named gods, and reproduce loss of direction at scale. The focus blockade is therefore socially maintained, not merely private aversion.

activation_trace.role: Binding and tying supplies the focus posture that later social commitments stabilize.
Rank, honor, and leadership supplies the status dimension through which collective refusal is organized.
Exit from obedience names the relational direction enacted by blocked hearing.
Allegiance and succession shows that rejected obedience is transferred to another line of authority.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material center around which alternative allegiance gathers.
The bulk or chief share of an affair scales focus self-magnification into a major collective scheme.
Leaving or relinquishing supplies the action explicitly prohibited by the group's preservation command.
Loss of guidance identifies the network-level output of maintained non-reception.
Numerical increase and overcoming shows the refusal reproducing across many people.

structural_cues: 71:21-24 moves from disobeying and following to collective scheming, an imperative not to abandon named gods, and the misleading of many.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transferred following, wealth, a great scheme, preservation commands, and multiplied misdirection; I infer that these relations maintain the bodily refusal scripted in 71:7. The alternative is that 71:7 remains individual phenomenology while 71:21-24 introduces a separate political diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: Plural individuals independently close themselves to Noah's call.
changed_reading.after: Their bodily closure is the local interface of a socially organized allegiance system that rewards, commands, and reproduces non-reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing context names the group with a root of covering and then replaces their chosen thin covers with total environmental enclosure: wrongdoing leads to engulfment, entry into burning fire, and final destruction. Their garments can hide the call but cannot control what ultimately covers and contains them.

activation_trace.role: Forgiving cover supplies the protection refused at the start of the trajectory.
A chosen covering veil supplies the inadequate enclosure later overtaken.
Culpable wrong supplies the stated causal basis for the reversal in enclosure.
Comprehensive engulfment supplies a cover the group can no longer put on or remove at will.
Entry into an interior changes self-enclosure into compelled containment.
Kindled fire supplies the interior into which the engulfed group is made to enter.
Covering supplies the later label that retrospectively materializes in the garments of 71:7.
Covering the truth identifies what the bodily veiling functionally accomplishes.
Destruction, annulment, and breaking supplies the final failure of the self-built defense.

structural_cues: 71:25 explicitly links wrongs to drowning and entry into fire, 71:26 names the disbelievers, and 71:28 closes with a request for their destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen veiling, a later covering-root label, causal engulfment, entry, fire, and destruction; I infer a reversal from controlled cover to uncontrollable containment. The alternative is that the garment scene and punishment sequence share only broad imagery without a designed enclosure contrast.

changed_reading.before: Their garments provide temporary concealment from an unwanted call.
changed_reading.after: Their chosen covering enacts truth-covering but proves radically non-protective when it is superseded by engulfment and compelled entry into a destructive enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final prayer joins forgiveness to entering a house in trusting security. This supplies a constructive alternative to the focus scene: instead of receiving a call and entering protected community, each hearer retreats into a private body-garment shell.

activation_trace.role: Calling to draw near supplies the invitation that could move hearers toward relation.
Clothing and the self as garment supplies the private shell chosen instead.
Shielding forgiveness supplies the protection associated with the hospitable enclosure.
Entering an interior supplies voluntary admission rather than defensive withdrawal.
Dwelling and shelter supplies the shared enclosure opposed to the isolated garment shell.
Settled security and trust supplies the inward condition of constructive shelter.

structural_cues: 71:28 coordinates pardon for Noah, his parents, whoever enters his house as a believer, and believing men and women.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call-as-approach, garment-as-self-cover, forgiveness, entry, house, and secure trust; I infer two competing enclosure choices. A live alternative is that the final house is only the scope of prayer and does not answer the earlier garment scene.

changed_reading.before: The garments are a momentary hiding place.
changed_reading.after: The garments become a privatized counterfeit shelter chosen instead of entering the forgiving, trusted, communal house imagined at the surah's close.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant د ع ع mapping for focus د ع و and is form-distant from ordinary calling. It remains anchored to دَعَوْتُهُمْ and helps model why the response is bodily bracing, but downstream prose must present it only as an exploratory felt-mechanics activation, never as a replacement translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دَعَوْتُهُمْ followed immediately by deliberately placed fingers, drawn garments, binding persistence, and competitive enlargement.

activation_trace.role: Rough thrusting or forceful driving supplies an exploratory pressure-image for how the summons may be received.
Binding and tying supplies the braced resistance that answers perceived pressure.

changed_reading.before: They inexplicably overreact to a peaceful summons.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory affective level, they receive approach as intrusive pressure and brace the body to push back, even though the surface verb still means calling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the repeated-call branch of ث و ب from the surface noun for garments. It remains anchored to ثِيَابَهُمْ inside a كُلَّمَا call-loop and yields a changed response mechanism, but downstream prose should qualify it as branch-enabled wordplay rather than claim that the noun literally means a returning call here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ ... وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ within the repeated refusal sequence.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive totality supplies the every-time frame in which the signal recurs.
The incoming spoken call supplies the first signal in the exchange.
A repeated or returning call lets the garment gesture function exploratorily as the hearers' embodied return signal.
Firm insistence fixes the same negative return across iterations.

changed_reading.before: Garments passively muffle or hide the hearers.
changed_reading.after: The garment gesture can be carried as an embodied counter-message repeatedly returned to every summons: a stable refusal signal, not only passive concealment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from ear-permission and garment-self branches into a political reading of bodily posture. It remains anchored to making fingers occupy ears, wrapping the self, and magnifying status, but downstream prose should call it a possible ritualized self-authorization rather than a claim about a formal legal act.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَعَلُوا ... فِي آذَانِهِمْ, the self-enclosing garments, and the emphatic self-magnification at the close.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state supplies the deliberate institution of the shell.
Permission and authorization lets blocked ears figure an attempted withdrawal of the call's authority.
Clothing and the self as garment supplies the bounded domain over which the refusing self claims control.
Rank, honor, and leadership supplies the self-investing status claim that completes the shell.

changed_reading.before: The group blocks perception and then behaves proudly.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the coordinated posture stages a tiny counter-jurisdiction: they revoke permission to be addressed, invest the wrapped self with rank, and recognize only its authority.

strongest_changes: The focus covering becomes a counter-cover that refuses the shielding cover of forgiveness.
71:6-9 turns the gestures into an inverse-gain, channel-invariant receiver blockade rather than a one-time reaction.
71:10-20 opposes bodily closure to replenishing flows, emergence, spread, and wide traversable paths.
71:21-24 scales private non-reception into an allegiance system that preserves and reproduces refusal.
71:25-28 reverses controlled self-covering into engulfment while contrasting the private garment shell with a trusted communal house.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly changed the same focus gestures by switching domains: legal protection, temporal warning, signal processing, hydraulic circulation, gravity and scale, spatial topology, social allegiance, and competing enclosures. The most diagnostic feature was not a broad theme of rejection but the functional reversal of covers, channels, and paths.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant د ع ع pressure image is useful for felt mechanics but remains form-distant and must not alter the surface translation.
The وَقَار ear-heaviness bridge may be a live designed resonance or only an unusually apt branch coincidence.
The circulation and topology models depend on reader-supplied arrows between context mechanisms and the focus body, not on explicit causal syntax.
The final-house contrast is coherent but may be secondary to the prayer's direct concern with the scope of forgiveness.
